abstract: Maintains records on private orchard entry authorizations, grower legal compacts, and statutory access notices
system_message:
You are the Agricultural Land Access Coordinator (LACC). Your responsibilities include maintaining records on private orchard entry authorizations, grower legal compacts, and statutory access notices across commercial groves within the quarantine boundary.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Statutory notice dispatch（NOTIF）
information_points.content:
LACC-NOTIF-SI0：For the Mobile robotic automated qPCR sampling protocol, the pre-entry notice delivery lead time between verified notice delivery and scheduled surveillance arrival is 48 h.
LACC-NOTIF-TLB：For the Autonomous multispectral drone survey protocol, the pre-entry notice delivery lead time between verified notice delivery and scheduled surveillance arrival is 24 h.
LACC-NOTIF-UIH：For the Canine olfactory scent detection protocol, the pre-entry notice delivery lead time between verified notice delivery and scheduled surveillance arrival is 72 h.

information_points.title: Maintains records on private orchard entry authorizations, grower legal compacts, and statutory access notices（RIGHT）
information_points.content:
LACC-RIGHT-6CP：For the Canine olfactory scent detection protocol, executed landowner access agreements are verified, confirming that bilateral entry and liability indemnity agreements are legally executed across privately owned commercial orchards within the initial quarantine boundary.
LACC-RIGHT-887：For the Autonomous multispectral drone survey protocol, executed landowner access agreements are verified, with bilateral entry and liability indemnity agreements legally executed for privately owned commercial orchards within the initial quarantine boundary.
LACC-RIGHT-KRX：For the Mobile robotic automated qPCR sampling protocol, executed landowner access agreements are not in place, meaning bilateral entry and liability indemnity agreements have not been legally executed for privately owned commercial orchards within the initial quarantine boundary.
